shared_elements: bird in profile with long neck and indicated wing
schematic incised/relief animal outlines with internal line details
justification: The strongest correspondence is the schematic profile bird with a long neck, small head/eye and internally marked wing, accompanied by other sinuous animal forms and separated by horizontal register lines. The biggest difference is that B has a much more structured stacked program including a prominent patterned band and anthropomorphic/architectural features, while A shows a more fragmentary cluster of animal figures without the same clear vertical sequence.
